content.label: Closing message
content.hint: Shown to the patient once they have completed and submitted the questionnaire.

link_used_message.label: Link already used
link_used_message.hint: Shown when a private link that already completed the survey is opened again. Leave empty to use the default English text.

survey_closed_message.label: Survey closed
survey_closed_message.hint: Shown when the survey is no longer available (not started, ended, completed or disabled). Leave empty to use the default English text.

resume_message.label: Resume questionnaire
resume_message.hint: Shown when a private link with a questionnaire in progress is opened again. Use {count} for the number of responses saved so far. Leave empty to use the default English text.

dialog.add_title: Add closing messages for a language

empty.title: No closing messages configured.
empty.description: Add a language to define the messages shown at the end of the questionnaire, when the link was already used, when the survey is closed and when a questionnaire is resumed.

language_bar.delete_language_description: This will remove all closing messages for "{{language}}".

actions.toggle_fallback_confirm_description: This changes which closing message is used as fallback for this survey.
